name: Vacation Urgent Forwarder
description: A Scout automation installer that, only during a configured vacation window, scans work email and Teams and forwards genuinely urgent items to your personal email.
author: Giorgio Ughini
coverImageAlt: A selective cyan-lit gate lets one orange urgent parcel reach a receiving tray while routine parcels wait behind.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a selective gate filters a quiet stream of work-message parcels, allowing only one genuinely urgent orange parcel to cross a protected boundary toward a small personal receiving tray
Scene/backdrop: serene vacation-blue distance behind a warm-paper foreground, with a compact slate filtering gate and calm negative space
Subject: one high-threshold gate, several muted blank parcels held back, and one orange urgent parcel moving through a cyan-lit channel
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject centered; no essential detail in the outer 8%; clear selective-filter metaphor at card size
Lighting/mood: protective, restrained, calm, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI, mail screenshot, or Microsoft Fluent branding
Correction: Simplify to one compact complete ensemble consisting only of the gate, a small group of waiting blank parcels, one orange urgent parcel, and one receiving tray, all fully visible and contained within the middle 60% of both canvas width and canvas height; leave every meaningful object at least 12% from every edge, with no cropped or edge-crossing form.
